review.heading: Check before it is written
review.blocked: Cannot adjust: the balance would fall below the allowed credit limit.
review.overLimit: After this change the seller is over their credit limit (balance below −limit).
review.checkStatement: I have checked this amount against the bank statement / supporting documents.
review.checkLimit: I confirm this limit has been approved.
review.bigAmount: Amounts of {{threshold}} or more must be checked before writing.
review.bigLimit: Raising the limit by {{threshold}} or more needs confirmation that it was approved.
review.retryHint: If the connection drops, just press again: the system recognises the same request and will not write twice.
review.networkError: The connection dropped before an answer arrived, so it is not known whether the write went through. Press again to be sure — the system will not write twice.

done.replayed: An earlier attempt of this request had already gone through — NOTHING more was written this time.
done.unchanged: The limit is unchanged, nothing was written.
